title: Amazon-Abrechnung zu DATEV: Settlement-Bericht im Browser in einen DATEV-Buchungsstapel umwandeln
pitch: For German Amazon sellers whose tax advisor books in DATEV and who rely on DATEV's Zahlungsdatenservice für Amazon (end 2027-08-15, known data gaps): upload the Amazon settlement report and download a checked DATEV EXTF booking batch (sales, fees, refunds, payout reconciliation) without granting API access. If it takes off it becomes the settlement-to-DATEV converter for every marketplace (eBay, Kaufland, Etsy) that tax advisors recommend to their clients.

evidence.note: DATEV warns of balance differences, outdated and missing data. Price from 1.36 EUR a month, end of service 2027-08-15, no successor named on the page. Undated page, opened 2026-11-12.
DATEV's discontinuation list: 'DATEV Zahlungsdatenservice für Amazon: 15.08.2027, discontinued'. Customer letters dated October 2026.
10 autocomplete variants, including 'amazon datev export', 'datev amazon zahlungsdatenservice' and 'datev amazon buchen'

competitors.name: Amainvoice
competitors.gap: A full Amazon accounting suite (invoices, OSS, Intrastat) from 39 EUR a month for 200 documents. Too dear for small sellers who paid DATEV 1.36 EUR a month.

competitors.name: Taxdoo
competitors.gap: E-commerce accounting and VAT suite, not a small single-job converter. Price not checked.

competitors.name: DATEV Datenservice Zahlungsdienstleister (Amazon Payments Europe)
competitors.gap: Seen only in search results. It may be DATEV's own successor. Not opened or checked.

competitors.name: DATEV Zahlungsdatenservice für Amazon
competitors.gap: Discontinued from 2027-08-15. DATEV already warns of wrong or missing data.

trigger.what: DATEV stops development, maintenance and service of its Zahlungsdatenservice für Amazon (Art.-Nr. 20496) on 2027-08-15 (end date; announcement date not shown) and already warns of balance differences, outdated and missing data

window: Users of the DATEV service must move before 2027-08-15. Pages that rank for 'datev amazon zahlungsdatenservice' in early 2027 catch the migration. After that it is a standing need that Amainvoice and Taxdoo also serve.
monetizationIdea: Small Amazon sellers (or their tax advisor on their behalf) pay a low monthly or yearly fee per marketplace account for a correct DATEV booking batch each month.

money.payer: A German Amazon seller with roughly 50 to 2,000 orders a month whose bookkeeping is done in DATEV by a tax advisor
money.buys: A monthly DATEV booking batch that reconciles to the Amazon payout. This saves the advisor's billable hours for manual booking and avoids balance differences now that DATEV's own service is ending.
money.price: 12 EUR a month or 99 EUR a year per marketplace account

proof.note: Amainvoice charges from 39 EUR a month (200 documents) up to 599 EUR a month and claims 2,700+ sellers for Amazon-to-DATEV preparation. Undated page (copyright 2025), opened 2026-11-12.
DATEV's own service costs from 1.36 EUR a month. This shows that the payer exists and also how low the price anchor is.

money.nobodyPaysIf: DATEV's Datenservice Zahlungsdienstleister turns out to be a cheap drop-in successor, or tax advisors simply move their clients to Amainvoice or Taxdoo, so a small converter is never chosen.

risks: Wrong bookings would anger tax advisors; needs a strict reconciliation check
edge: Runs from the uploaded settlement report in the browser, with no Amazon API connection and no data upload, at a price near DATEV's old one. Checked: Amainvoice starts at 39 EUR a month and is a full suite. Not checked: whether Amainvoice needs API access.
